name: Jettison
product: Jettison by St. Clair Software

evidence.says: St. Clair Software dates Jettison 1.9.7 to August 7, 2026, and lists native support for Intel and Apple Silicon.

name: Syntronik
product: Syntronik by IK Multimedia

evidence.says: An IK Multimedia representative confirms Syntronik was discontinued and that license holders retain access in IK Product Manager.

limitation: The final macOS version and its CPU architecture were not established.
notes: The scanned bundle belongs to the original Syntronik series.

name: Saffire MixControl
product: Saffire Mix Control for Focusrite Saffire FireWire interfaces

evidence.says: Focusrite identifies Saffire Mix Control 3.9 as the final Mac software release for the discontinued Saffire range.
Focusrite ended Saffire FireWire development support in October 2019 and lists macOS Catalina as the last officially supported macOS.

limitation: Focusrite calls the binary 64-bit without specifying its CPU slices.

name: 4K Video Downloader+
product: 4K Video Downloader Plus by Open Media (4K Download)

evidence.says: 4K Download lists a dedicated Apple Silicon macOS installer for 4K Video Downloader Plus 26.4.0.0406, dated November 11, 2026.

notes: The scan bundle ID identifies the Plus edition, which has its own release line.

name: MusicBrainz Picard
product: MusicBrainz Picard by MetaBrainz Foundation

evidence.says: The official download table offers Picard 3.0.5 for macOS 13.0 and later as separate arm64 and x86_64 builds.
MetaBrainz announced the Picard 3.0.5 release on November 12, 2026.

name: Grisbi
product: Grisbi personal finance manager by the Grisbi project

evidence.says: The Grisbi project homepage announces 3.92.0 as its current download.
The project's release directory lists Grisbi-3.92.0-arm64.dmg dated October 23, 2026 and identifies it as the Apple Silicon build for macOS 15 or later.

notes: The disabled Homebrew cask still refers to the older 3.0.4 release.

name: MINDSTORMS Home
product: LEGO MINDSTORMS EV3 Home Edition by the LEGO Group

evidence.says: LEGO says the EV3 Home Edition is no longer available and lists Classroom separately.

limitation: The final Home Edition version and its binary architecture could not be verified.

name: Qfinder Pro
product: Qfinder Pro for macOS by QNAP

evidence.says: QNAP says Qfinder Pro for Mac is universal with native Intel and Apple Silicon support from 7.13.1 onward.
Homebrew identifies the current QNAP download as QNAPQfinderProMac-7.14.1.0727.dmg.

name: Fing
product: Fing Desktop for macOS by Fing

evidence.says: Fing states that Fing Desktop 4.0 onward runs only on Apple Silicon.
Homebrew identifies the current Mac package as Fing-4.0.3-mac.zip on Fing’s download server.

name: EagleFiler
product: EagleFiler by C-Command Software

evidence.says: C-Command dates release 1.9.22 and explains that EagleFiler runs on Apple Silicon through Rosetta 2 because the app still relies on Intel libraries.

notes: The search indexer already runs natively. The vendor is rewriting the main app.

name: Solstice
product: Mersive Solstice desktop client by Mersive Technologies

evidence.says: Mersive lists an Apple Silicon macOS client in the 6.3.5 release and identifies 6.3.3 as the first native Apple Silicon client.

limitation: Mersive labels 6.3.5 as a November release without giving an exact day.
notes: The Apple Silicon client omits the Room Camera + Mic option for Solstice video conferencing.

name: MoticImageDevices
product: Motic Image Devices, the image-capture component of Motic Images Plus by Motic

evidence.says: Motic documents MI Devices as the camera-capture interface that transfers images to the image manipulation program.
Motic's product brochure describes MI Devices as the capture component bundled with the separate Motic Images Plus processing application.

limitation: The component's current executable version and architecture were not established.
notes: Keep any standalone Motic Images Plus listing separate from this capture component.

name: VIP Access
product: Symantec VIP Access for Desktop (macOS) by Broadcom

evidence.says: The Symantec VIP product team announced native Apple Silicon support for VIP Access Desktop for Mac 1.0.8 on July 31, 2026.
Inspection of VIPAccessSecurityCode.dmg found both x86_64 and arm64 in the Mach-O header of VIP Access.app/Contents/MacOS/VIP Access.
A customer reports that the distributed installer failed on an M4 Max without Rosetta, and a Broadcom support reply advises installing Rosetta.

limitation: The main app executable is universal, but installation without Rosetta was not verified.
notes: Broadcom's community reply conflicts with its release announcement, while inspection confirms an arm64 slice in the app executable.

name: CFX Concert Grand
product: Garritan Abbey Road Studios CFX Concert Grand standalone player by MakeMusic

evidence.says: Garritan documents CFX Concert Grand in the Mac Applications folder as a standalone player.
MakeMusic identifies the dedicated CFX Concert Grand player as Intel-only and says it requires Rosetta 2 on Apple Silicon.
MakeMusic lists the CFX Concert Grand library among libraries that can run natively in the separate ARIA Player 2.026.

limitation: MakeMusic's architecture guidance does not give a version for the dedicated player.
notes: The scanned bundle is the dedicated standalone player. The same sound library can run natively in the separate ARIA Player 2.026.

name: 0xED
product: 0xED hex editor by Suavetech

evidence.says: MacUpdater identifies the exact Suavetech bundle, marks it discontinued, and lists 1.1.4 build 98 dated January 26, 2017 with Intel and PowerPC architectures only.

limitation: The former developer site did not resolve, so the final release and its architecture are based on MacUpdater's catalog.
notes: The final recorded build lacks Apple Silicon support. Its historical universal binary supported Intel and PowerPC.

name: Moneydance
product: Moneydance desktop personal finance manager by The Infinite Kind

evidence.says: The Infinite Kind offers Moneydance 2024.4 build 5253 for macOS.
The Infinite Kind confirms that the current release family is universal and runs natively on Intel and Apple Silicon.
The stable changelog dates Moneydance 2024.4 build 5253 to February 20, 2025.

notes: The scanned 2020 build predates the universal Mac releases.

name: Blitz
product: Blitz desktop gaming companion by Blitz.gg

evidence.says: Blitz's macOS update feed dated November 20, 2026 lists version 3.0.29 and names both official Mac packages universal.
The Blitz cask matches the com.blitz.app bundle and points to the vendor's universal 3.0.29 DMG.

name: SampleTank 3 Instruments Installer
product: SampleTank 3 Instruments Installer and Sound Library Updater by IK Multimedia

evidence.says: A firsthand SampleTank 3 installation guide shows Sound Library Update 3.5 being applied after the separate sound-content installers.

notes: The submitted bundle installs or updates SampleTank 3 sound content.

name: AmneziaVPN
product: AmneziaVPN macOS desktop client by Amnezia

evidence.says: The publisher lists a single Mac package for 5.1.1.10, identified as x64 and uploaded November 19, 2026.
An Apple Silicon user reports that the Intel desktop package installs successfully once Rosetta is installed.
A firsthand report records the standalone x86_64 client running through Rosetta on an Apple Silicon Mac.

limitation: The firsthand Rosetta reports cover earlier releases than 5.1.1.10.
notes: The iOS App Store build is a separate distribution.

name: Philharmonik 2
product: Miroslav Philharmonik 2 standalone by IK Multimedia

evidence.says: IK Multimedia Japan lists Philharmonik 2.0.6 under applications and plug-ins confirmed to work on Apple Silicon via Rosetta 2.
MacUpdater identifies the exact standalone bundle, lists version 2.0.6 as Intel, and dates it to January 17, 2020.

notes: The SampleTank 4 library can load the sounds separately from the Philharmonik 2 standalone app.

name: Tc Employeehub
product: Tencent Employee Hub (腾讯员工平台), as named by the submitted bundle

evidence.says: The listing records a 1.4.0 upload for com.tc.employeehub with Tencent Employee Hub and x86_64 in the filename.

limitation: No public vendor source or official current build could be located to verify the app’s distribution or current architecture.
notes: The submission appears to describe an employee-facing application.

name: NordPass
product: NordPass desktop password manager by Nord Security

evidence.says: NordPass explicitly provides separate Apple Silicon and Intel builds for macOS.
NordPass’s Apple Silicon update feed lists version 7.13.7 with a November 23, 2026 release date.

name: FinderMinder
product: FinderMinder by Irradiated Software

evidence.says: Irradiated Software describes FinderMinder and links its Mac download.
The official ZIP contains FinderMinder.app/Contents/MacOS/FinderMinder with x86_64 and i386 slices only, and its Info.plist identifies version 1.3 (build 333).

limitation: Successful operation under Rosetta 2 was not verified.
notes: The Labs page labels the download v1.3.1 while the served app reports its short version as 1.3.

name: FluoroCT
product: FluoroCT cardiovascular CT visualization for macOS, originally by Pascal Thériault-Lauzier

evidence.says: The recorded 3.4 scan identifies bundle PTL.FluoroCT, credits Circle Cardiovascular Imaging, and reports an x86 executable.
Apple's US lookup endpoint returns zero results for FluoroCT's historical Mac App Store ID 898647792.
A mirror of the earlier Mac App Store listing credits Pascal Thériault-Lauzier and describes FluoroCT as a CT visualization app.

limitation: No currently distributed build, project retirement statement, or current architecture was found.
notes: The historical 3.4 Intel scan does not establish what, if anything, is currently distributed.

name: Spek
product: Spek acoustic spectrum analyser by Alexander Kojevnikov

evidence.says: The upstream download page identifies Spek 0.8.5 as current and its macOS installer as beta.
The developer identifies the macOS 0.8.5 beta installer as Intel-built and says it should work with Apple ARM chips.
The upstream release assets date the macOS beta DMG to February 11, 2023.
A firsthand report confirms the maintainer's 2023 Mac beta works on an M2 Mac.
Homebrew separately builds a native Apple Silicon bottle of Spek 0.8.5.

notes: The disposition covers the upstream Mac DMG. Homebrew offers a native downstream build.

name: The Unofficial Homestuck Collection
product: The Unofficial Homestuck Collection by Bambosh and GiovanH

evidence.says: The maintained upstream repository publishes release 2.7.3, whose DMG main executable was inspected as x86_64 only and matched the submitted bundle ID.
The next release notes that automatic macOS builds may cease and supplies no current Mac build.
The Homebrew cask documents Rosetta 2 as a requirement for the preceding Intel release 2.7.2.

limitation: The Rosetta compatibility guidance covers 2.7.2. The 2.7.3 executable was inspected without a runtime test.
notes: Inspected The-Unofficial-Homestuck-Collection-2.7.3.dmg at The Unofficial Homestuck Collection.app/Contents/MacOS/The Unofficial Homestuck Collection. The collection requires a matching asset pack.

name: AVCHD to Mov Lite
product: AVCHD to Mov Lite by Geranium Software

evidence.says: The developer's Mac App Store listing shows version 2.2.5 from September 30, 2018 as the latest release.
The existing scan for the same bundle and version reports only X86 in its architecture data.

limitation: The published X86 architecture label does not establish Rosetta 2 runtime compatibility.

name: WD Drive Utilities
product: WD Drive Utilities by Western Digital

evidence.says: Western Digital continues to link its current Mac utility for supported WD drives.
The official archive contains WD Drive Utilities 2.1.6.434 with bundle ID com.wdc.branded.driveutility and a main executable inspected as x86_64 only.

limitation: No firsthand Rosetta confirmation or vendor release date was found for the current build.
notes: Inspected WD Drive Utilities.app/Contents/MacOS/WD Drive Utilities from the installer DMG's nested WD Drive Utilities.zip.

name: Clover Configurator
product: Clover Configurator Global Edition by mackie100 projects

evidence.says: The developer's changelog dates Clover Configurator 5.30.0.0 to November 3, 2026.

The official CCG.zip contains Clover Configurator.app/Contents/MacOS/Clover Configurator as an x86_64-only Mach-O, and the app plist identifies bundle org.altervista.mackie100projects.Clover-Configurator at version 5.30.0.0.

limitation: No runtime confirmation for this specific version under Rosetta 2 was found.
notes: The application's own architecture is separate from the hardware supported by the Clover EFI bootloader it configures.

name: American Truck Simulator
product: American Truck Simulator for macOS by SCS Software

evidence.says: SCS Software announced the stable Steam release of version 1.62 on November 3, 2026.
An M1 MacBook Air user reports running the game via Rosetta 2.
A player reports running version 1.61 through Rosetta 2 on an M4 Mac mini and later confirms playing version 1.62 on the same system.

limitation: The 1.62 Mach-O was not independently inspected.

name: SuperTab
product: SuperTab by SpriTec Software

evidence.says: MacUpdater identifies SpriTec SuperTab 5.1.2 for com.spritec.supertab and catalogs it as Intel and Apple Silicon.
MacPlus Software says the original SuperTab stopped working and describes its own SuperTab 7 as a rebuild from scratch.

limitation: Version 5.1.2 is the latest SpriTec build independently cataloged in this audit, and its universal architecture was not independently inspected.
notes: The Homebrew hint is for MacPlus Software’s separate SuperTab 7, whose downloaded 1.2.2 build has bundle ID com.macplus-software.com.SuperTab-7.

name: XFUtility3
product: Canon XF Utility for macOS by Canon

evidence.says: Canon lists XF Utility 3.16.10 for macOS and identifies its official ZIP as package version 3.16.10.1.
Inspection of the XFUtility3.app installer payload found bundle version 3.16.10.1 and both x86_64 and arm64 slices in XFUtility3.app/Contents/MacOS/XFUtility3.

limitation: Canon’s regional support pages show their update dates without identifying a single exact release date.

name: Macgo Blu-ray Player
product: Macgo Mac Blu-ray Player (standard edition) by Macgo

evidence.says: Macgo’s standard-edition update feed tops out at version 3.3.23, dated March 15, 2025.
The versioned Homebrew cask marks standard-edition 3.3.23 no longer available and declares its Rosetta requirement.
A Blu-ray software guide records that Macgo marked both editions discontinued while historical downloads continued to work.

notes: The final listed standard edition was Intel-only per Homebrew. Macgo’s legacy download CDN still responds.

name: easyDCP Player+
product: easyDCP Player+ by Fraunhofer IIS and easyDCP GmbH

evidence.says: The vendor changelog covers Player+, lists 4.3.5 as its newest release, and records the switch to a universal Mac app in 4.2.0.
The vendor's compatibility table for 4.2.4 onward lists Player+ support on both Intel macOS and macOS on Apple M-series processors.

limitation: The latest installer requires a vendor account, and the public changelog does not date the 4.3.5 release.
notes: The scan captured the much older 3.0.1 build.

name: Jaspersoft Studio
product: Jaspersoft Studio, the Eclipse-based report designer from TIBCO Jaspersoft, now Actian

evidence.says: The vendor's Mac Community Edition page lists Jaspersoft Studio 7.0.8 with a changelog dated August 14, 2026.
Actian's Studio installation guide lists only x86_64 macOS packages for the Eclipse-based Community and Commercial editions.
A report designer describes using Jaspersoft Studio under Rosetta on an Apple Silicon Mac.
Actian identifies Jaspersoft Desktop as the successor to the Eclipse-based Jaspersoft Studio.

limitation: The installation guide gives the package architecture by edition, and the firsthand Rosetta report does not name build 7.0.8.
notes: 7.0.8 identifies the Community Edition release. The separate Jaspersoft Desktop early-access app has Apple Silicon support.

name: Suuntolink
product: SuuntoLink by Suunto

evidence.says: Suunto dates its latest SuuntoLink release, 4.1.15, to April 3, 2024.
Inspection of the official DMG found com.suunto.Suuntolink version 4.1.15 with an x86_64-only Mach-O at Suuntolink.app/Contents/MacOS/Suuntolink.
A user reports that the downloaded SuuntoLink worked on an M4 Mac after installing Rosetta.

name: mediaget
product: MediaGet BitTorrent client by Bergarius Limited

evidence.says: MediaGet advertises a standalone macOS DMG and does not state its version or CPU architecture.
MediaGet says it works on M1, M2 and M3 Macs without identifying the build or whether Rosetta is used.

limitation: The official Mac download did not yield a verifiable current version or Mach-O architecture.
notes: The submitted 1.0.0 plist identifies Bergarius Limited.

name: ContraptionMaker
product: Contraption Maker by Spotkin, now maintained by Kevin Ryan and published by Top Meadow

evidence.says: The publisher distributes a macOS build of Contraption Maker via Steam.
Steam's public build shares build ID 15710007 with version 1.4.33 and was published on September 16, 2024.
The submitted com.spotkin.ContraptionMaker 1.4.33 scan reports only X86.
Developer Kevin Ryan confirms that Spotkin handed him the same game and that updates continued through Steam and other stores.

limitation: The full Steam build was not independently tested under Rosetta. A firsthand M1 report describes only the demo.

name: Cricut Design Space
product: Cricut Design Space for Desktop by Cricut

evidence.says: Cricut's production macOS arm64 release manifest identifies 10.12.122 as current, names its installer and update archives, and dates the rollout to November 16, 2026.
Cricut lists Desktop 10.12 as a stable release on November 16 and lists 10.13 as beta.

notes: Cricut also maintains a separate x64 release channel. The small website download is an installer stub with a separate bundle ID.

name: SYNTHTRIBE
product: Behringer SYNTHTRIBE desktop synthesizer editor and firmware utility

evidence.says: Behringer lists Synthtribe 3.3.0 for macOS in its POLYEIGHT downloads.
The vendor's 3.3.0 DMG contains an arm64-only Synthtribe.app with bundle ID com.behringer.synthtribe.
Behringer's Japanese distributor lists the legacy and newer Mac releases under the same SYNTHTRIBE utility.
The Wave community also distributes a 3.3.1 Mac DMG whose main executable was inspected as arm64.

limitation: The vendor release date for 3.3.0 was not found.
notes: Inspected Synthtribe.app/Contents/MacOS/Synthtribe in the official 3.3.0 DMG and the community-hosted 3.3.1 DMG. The bundle ID changed from com.behringer.synthtool to com.behringer.synthtribe. The inspected 3.0.2 DMG with the old bundle ID was x86_64.
